how: Members recruit helpers for an identifiable zombie face and repeat calls as defense becomes necessary.
Collective calls and pronouns describe an active subset rather than proving that the whole membership placed pixels or endorsed its decisions.
A short doing-so reply explicitly accepts a defense request without demanding anything in return.
A defense call receives a bare action-report reply, supporting the observable call-and-answer mechanism without establishing obligations or silent acceptance by other readers.
Members explicitly judge additional lettering short of helpers and greater territory harder to maintain.
One member proposes representation while another turns that proposal into a concrete request and coordinates that others offer to follow.
An initial proposal is developed into a specific call for helpers and a posted location, with starting distributed across participants.
Members propose names, backgrounds, extra figures and altered features as competing ways to represent the game.
Design proposals and corrections remain unsettled when helpers or shared knowledge of the intended face are lacking.
Participants report partial construction, damage, recovery and individual fixes rather than documenting only finished art.
The record supports a narrated call-and-build sequence, but action reports cannot establish that each separate alarm caused more placing.
Coordinates and confirmation of a posted template give helpers common reference points for the face.
Posting a template does not demonstrate prior design agreement or subsequent settlement when participants still dispute the intended features.
Planning moves into a separate chat while instructions return to the subreddit, requiring an explicit backstage route in the standing process account.
Explicit movement of planning into Discord leaves decided canvas organisation unresolved, while visible subreddit removals establish host moderation only.
The element must distinguish arguing over machine hands and intending their use from verified deployment, which these passages do not establish.
Defense pressure reaches a contested adoption decision whose outcome depends on whether participants accept automation as compatible with community building.
Participants watch overnight, report constant repair and repeatedly ask for damaged eyes to be fixed.
The edited completion account turns directly toward correcting features and keeping griefers away, while expanding would increase maintenance costs.
Participants distinguish hostile changes from inaccurate friendly placing and mistakes by their own members.
Repair includes identifying friendly errors and disagreements about correct features rather than treating every changed pixel as an attack.
Provisional celebration returns to feature correction and defense before closure, requiring a return path from marking completion to maintenance.
Participants celebrate a recognizable result while explicitly acknowledging remaining pixel errors, making completion a checkpoint rather than termination.
Members and visitors negotiate coexistence, claims and disputed borders through specific proposals and responses.
A complaint about an intruding border receives an answering report of repair, directly connecting defending a square with negotiating its edge.
Visitors carry offers of defense and requests for assistance on behalf of neighbouring groups without establishing authority over every member.
A conditional protection offer receives an explicit deal and reported pixel, demonstrating reciprocal help at the exchange level.
Negotiating return protection directly produces an accepted deal and reported help within one exchange, without proving a causal link from earlier border conflict.
An offer to defend another community receives a promise of joint work and reciprocal defense, meeting the smallest alliance range.
Help under simultaneous attack is visible, but the coded offers do not establish that exhausted manpower caused the room to initiate each request.
A visitor offers an alliance that participants reciprocate, so common defensive strain does not by itself establish the room initiated a coalition because it lacked hands.
Participants urge respect for others and defending a small patch, while a separate instruction explicitly forbids invading neighbours.
Restraint can be justified by avoiding further enemies and limiting maintenance costs without evidence that a settled border produced it.
Move proposals and instructions to shrink establish considered or planned adaptation, while completed relocation remains unverified.
Capacity constraints can produce reduced ambitions and continued defense rather than collective withdrawal or a completed move.
The observed coexistence and protection negotiations do not establish accepted host jurisdiction over the community drawing.
Disputes over space and terms do not establish a challenge to who can bind all placers to an agreement.
Negotiations are observed but no coded response contests the negotiator's mandate, leaving the tentative authority-dispute endpoint unobserved.
Participants invoke representing themselves and retaining the game's recognizable roots, supporting a modest inherited community identification rather than a doctrine governing all action.
The coded retaliation names a current brigade and provides no evidence of a quarrel carried into the canvas from before the event.
A target named through a current attack accusation does not establish that a prior rivalry selected it.
Participants identify and protect April Fools rumours, joke about cosmetics and criticise the official game prank.
Joke-day framing includes reactions to usable game additions and does not establish that the later canvas call was a fake or unserious proposal.
Participants turn joke-day additions into practical teaching, testing and feature proposals, a local process lost by classifying the stereo theme only as ordinary talk.
Moderators centralize the flood in a megathread and remove subsequent posts while members redirect continuing calls there.
The moderator explicitly names mass posting as the reason for creating a megathread, corroborated by complaints that defense requests bury ordinary discussion.
Participants celebrate provisional completion, credit helpers and describe their own labour while repair continues.
A viewer explicitly arrives at the subreddit through its pixel art, requiring a visibility return from the canvas into the community.
Members mark placement closure, mourn losses and post a final image while disagreeing over how much survived.
Celebration and final-image recording occur together without establishing a shared outcome judgment or that celebration caused documentation.
Remembering the ending includes preserving conflicting assessments of survival rather than reducing them to one settled result.
A participant points others to a successor canvas, meeting the proposal-level range while leaving actual migration and sustained participation unresolved.
The successor proposal follows final-image posting but does not attribute continuation to that record, so its causal mechanism remains unobserved.
Preserving a record involves choosing which subreddit posts to retain while moderators report applying a broader removal rule.
Subreddit curation controls which records of the canvas effort remain visible, connecting host moderation to collective memory.
Different survival judgments and a final image establish memory work but do not establish shared-copy cleanup or correction of an account misrepresenting the group.
A participant explicitly calls for damage to a named opponent's art in retaliation, establishing an attack call rather than a verified raid.
The local attack call explicitly attributes its target to a perceived brigade, making retaliatory attribution the stated trigger beyond recruitment alone.
Claiming to have held off neighbouring figures supplies a limited victory statement without establishing an extended exchange of taunts.
Restraint is visible elsewhere, but no coded reply connects it to the retaliation call as an answering refusal.
Later border complaints do not recall the retaliation call, leaving its proposed conversion into negotiation unobserved.
The victory claim concerns different neighbours and precedes the retaliation call, so it cannot establish the proposed attack-to-contest sequence.
